items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Mr. Maurez asked me would I um come to Tony Almerickles at the Parisian Room that Sunday and do a number and I did

ctx.x: did you ever get that case of line?

no I guess he got mad because he said over the radio he said everyday I'd listen to hear what he was going to say if he'd say that I won you know and he said say Jivers listen to this somebody told me that I can't sing so I felt that he got mad so I felt that he got mad you know and he I've been tempted two three times since I've been back to say something to him about the letter you know but he's never brought it up you know either so I said well no I won't say nothing I will remind him I said but uh Mr. Joe…
Fine, now you were at the Almerickles you were at the paddock then for eight weeks Yeah Did you come directly from there here? Yeah Steve Davila heard you down there was that it?
